title: Visibility-Graph-Based Relative Strength Indicator for Financial Market Decision-Making
abstract: arXiv:2605.01300v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This study introduces the Visibility-Graph-Based Relative Strength Index (VGRSI), a causal indicator that selects and implicitly weights price increments using backward natural visibility. Independent parameters specify the aggregation window and the backward visibility range. Two aggregation variants use the magnitudes and counts of positive and negative contributions to produce values on a 0--100 scale. The VGRSI was tested in an automated walk-forward experiment based on 30-day optimisation windows followed by {7-day walk-forward windows}. This study covered DJI30, EUR/USD, and XAU/USD over 503 trading days in 2024--2025. {The VGRSI strategy produced positive cumulative net profits for all three instruments, whereas the tested classical-RSI strategy and the VGRSI variant without visibility selection produced cumulative losses under the same walk-forward procedure and trading conditions. translated_title: 面向金融市场决策的基于可见性图的相对强弱指标
translated_abstract: 本研究提出了一种基于可见性图的相对强弱指数（VGRSI），这是一种因果性指标，利用后向自然可见性来选择并隐式加权价格增量。独立参数分别指定聚合窗口和后向可见性范围。两种聚合变体利用正负贡献的幅度和数量来产生0至100范围内的数值。VGRSI在一种自动化前推验证实验中进行了测试，该实验采用30天优化窗口加7天前推窗口的方式。本研究覆盖了2024至2025年间共503个交易日的道琼斯工业指数（DJI30）、欧元/美元（EUR/USD）和黄金/美元（XAU/USD）。在相同的前推验证程序和交易条件下，VGRSI策略在所有三种金融工具上均产生了正的累计净利润，而所测试的经典RSI策略以及不含可见性选择的VGRSI变体则产生了累计亏损。由于该分析仅涵盖……
tldr: 本文提出基于可见性图的相对强弱指标VGRSI，利用后向自然可见性选择并加权价格增量，在前推测试中对DJI30、欧元/美元和黄金/美元均实现正累计净利润，表现优于经典RSI策略。
en_tdlr: A visibility-graph-based Relative Strength Index (VGRSI) that uses backward natural visibility to select and implicitly weight price increments achieved positive cumulative net profits on DJI30, EUR/USD, and XAU/USD in walk-forward tests, outperforming both the classical RSI strategy and a variant without visibility selection.
